mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 1.0% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.3% over a 3-month window signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to raise rates, which in turn depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 4.3%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.15 million units per month signals strong household demand and rising inflation expectations, which trigger preemptive monetary tightening and reduce equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1150.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 104.0 index level over two consecutive months signals weakening real economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 104.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand growth that accelerates inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously, or the interaction-based Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% per annum, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals that inflation is outpacing monetary policy response, increasing expectations of future rate hikes and reducing equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with delayed policy response
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% and FEDFUNDS is ≤1.2%, or the interaction-based Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200,000 jobs per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a labor market that is overheating, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 and UNRATE is below 4.3%, or the interaction-based Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 480,000 million dollars, combined with a rising GDP growth rate, signals strong underlying demand that increases inflationary pressures and triggers preemptive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS exceeds 480000.0 and GDPC1 exceeds 17000.0, or the interaction-based Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
